idea-plugin.name: Catthode Theme
idea-plugin.description:
A warm OLED UI and editor theme for IntelliJ-based IDEs.

  • Pure-black surfaces with white text and amber, gold, clay, tan, and wheat accents.
  • Editor coverage for common language syntax, diagnostics, terminal output, diffs, and version control.
idea-plugin.change-notes: First public release with the Catthode UI theme, editor scheme, warm terminal colors, and version-control states.
